svg.title: Sleep Paralysis Companion project architecture
svg.desc: Complete repository-grounded architecture diagram for the native SwiftUI iOS app, local-first persistence and synchronization, Supabase backend contracts, privacy boundaries, and GitHub Actions verification evidence.
svg.text: Complete project architecture · repository-grounded native iOS + local-first data + Supabase contracts
Checked-out source and canonical phase documents · 10 Aug 2026 · compatibility-sensitive identifiers retained where required
SwiftUI views, typed navigation, system entry points
Actor isolation, GRDB, protected files, offline queue
Auth, RLS/RPC mutation boundary, deletion, hosted verification
creates configuration, privacy-safe logger, access policy, authentication, and store
SwiftUI emits typed intent; views do not call persistence, Supabase, AVFoundation, or networking directly.
Domain · Core · Configuration · DataInterfaces · PlatformInterfaces · DesignSystem
explicit user/profile binding; no sync without authenticated user + queued operation
Offline writes enqueue idempotent operations; retry/conflict/authRequired remain explicit.
user ID must match local profile
Supabase stores account-linked metadata and check-in/persona state; personal audio remains device-local by contract.
The repository separates implementation, local/runtime proof, hosted CI proof, and production/device claims.
SwiftUI target · sources · tests · widget · project.yml
product spec · privacy · data lifecycle · threat model
architecture · data boundaries · gates · evidence contracts
Controlling rule: supplied product evidence and canonical contracts outrank stale implementation notes.
build · unit tests · UI tests · visual journey
isolated migrations · RLS · RPC · Deno tests
Artifacts: xcresult, screenshots/MP4, generated project, migrations, pgTAP results.
Exact-head SHA, job result, and artifact are required for gate claims.
CI ≠ production OAuth, signing, or live Supabase confirmation
Unavailable proof remains NOT PASSED / unknown, not inferred as passed
This is an architecture map, not a claim that every phase gate is currently accepted.
